Applied analysis at [EcoAustria](https://ecoaustria.ac.at/){target="_blank"} on trade, industrial and climate policy, digital competitiveness, and AI, including studies commissioned by the Austrian Federal Chancellery, federal ministries, and the Vienna Business Agency. Most reports are in German.
